proposedOperatorData.tagline: Kayak, paddleboard and open-water swim kit hire on Llyn Padarn, Llanberis
proposedOperatorData.description:
Snowdonia Watersports is a family-run kayak, stand-up paddleboard, and open-water swimming kit hire and retail outlet on the shore of Llyn Padarn in Llanberis, inside Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park. The business has traded from Unit 2, Y Glyn, Llanberis since 2016 (previously known as SurfLines) and holds a current AALA/HSE adventure activities licence covering canoeing, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding through July 2028.

Hire sessions are self-guided rather than instructor-led: customers collect kayaks, tandem kayaks, SUPs, or group paddleboards along with paddles, buoyancy aids and wetsuits, then launch directly onto Llyn Padarn from Padarn Country Park, with no on-water supervision provided. The shop also sells watersports equipment from brands including Red Paddle Co, Starboard, Palm, Orca, and Dryrobe.

The site sits beside the Lone Tree Cafe with views across the lake to Snowdon and Dolbadarn Castle. TripAdvisor reviewers (73 reviews, #2 of 5 water sports operators in Llanberis) consistently praise friendly staff, good-value hire, and the free nearby parking, while noting hire sessions are unsupervised so paddlers should be confident in the water.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Self-service kayak, SUP, and open-water swim kit hire directly on the shore of Llyn Padarn with an AALA-licensed operator, plus an on-site retail shop for watersports gear.
